theorem QOU.StandardModel.LevelParity.carrier_component_parity :
(writhe (sigma1Pow 1) - 2) % 2 = ↑(components 2 (sigma1Pow 1)) % 2 ∧ (writhe (sigma1Pow 2) - 2) % 2 = ↑(components 2 (sigma1Pow 2)) % 2 ∧ (writhe (sigma1Pow 3) - 2) % 2 = ↑(components 2 (sigma1Pow 3)) % 2 ∧ (writhe (sigma1Pow 5) - 2) % 2 = ↑(components 2 (sigma1Pow 5)) % 2 ∧ (writhe (sigma1Pow 7) - 2) % 2 = ↑(components 2 (sigma1Pow 7)) % 2 ∧ (writhe gluonUnit - 3) % 2 = ↑(components 3 gluonUnit) % 2 ∧ (writhe borromean - 3) % 2 = ↑(components 3 borromean) % 2
